description: IPC for the bundled UI's connection picker (AC5) and the app-managed local daemon (ADR-0013 part D2): list/add/remove/select a daemon connection, read the current one, open an http(s) link in the OS browser, and install/update/restart/take-over the local daemon. Scoped to the loopback proxy origin only -- the daemon/relay content served through it never gets these commands.
